# Get Dictionary From Input

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets a dictionary from the given input.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getDictionaryFrom(input: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getDictionaryFrom(input: ShortcutInput)
~~~~
